title: Araham
text: 2. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || pe || paññindriyaṃ || || 3. Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako imesam pañcannam indriyānam assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti || ayam vuccati bhikkhave arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohītabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto ti || ||
